meta.title: Anime model avatars and thinking style
meta.description: Shows an anime character avatar before DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax and Qwen models in the model picker; Kimi runs a moon indicator in moon-shadow gray, GLM a swishing fox tail in pure white/black, Qwen a folding fan in blue-violet and MiniMax a camera in red-orange, each labelled in its own words.
